english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the flow of blood through the body, especially in medical or health contexts.
This is the everyday term for blood circulation and the related movement of blood through the body.

examples.english: The doctor said my bloodstream isn't very good, so I need to exercise more.
examples.traditional: 醫生話我血液循環唔係幾好，要多啲做運動。
